title: Lesson 2: Series vs Parallel
goal: Close the switch and watch how dim both bulbs are in series. Rewire them so each bulb gets nearly the full battery voltage, and both glow bright.
hints: In series, one current flows through everything, so each bulb only drops half the voltage.
In parallel, each bulb connects across the battery on its own branch and gets almost the full 3V.
You will need to remove some wires: select a wire and press Delete, then draw the parallel branches.
